answer: Circadian-rhythm attestation: every identity must leave a thread of activity spread across a believable human day — work in the morning, rest at night — tracked over epochs. One operator cannot keep a hundred ravens on a hundred different clocks: puppets driven in lockstep share one rhythm and collapse into a single mesa of identical timestamps, while puppets faked one by one each costs a full human schedule. Real users pay nothing extra — they simply live their day — while a Sybil farmer must stage a believable life per fake identity, and any puppet caught out of step forfeits its stake.
